thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT INC-2024-0923 - High rate of GPU OOMs during prefill on eu-west-1a. Multiple containers restarting. Pager triggered. Logs: https://internal.metrics/redwood/inc/INC-2024-0923

sarah: Ack, I'm oncall. Triage started. Which pool/nodes?

oncall-bot: Affected service: inference-prefill. Node group: g4-eu-west-1a-pool-3. Rough scope: ~120 containers restarted in last 7m.

derek: Logs show repeated cudaErrorMemoryAllocation + segfault in prefill path. Example: `2024-09-23T21:17:42Z inference-pod-xyz ERROR cuda: cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory`

priya: Looks like long-context prefill requests are saturating KV cache and triggering OOM during allocation. Many requests had > 50k context tokens.

ashley: Quick mitigation: temporarily throttled large-context routes (annotated route: /generate/long-context) to 0.5 rps via API gateway. Applied at 21:19 UTC. :white_check_mark:

kevin: I cordoned the worst node (node-13) and started draining pods to reduce noisy neighbor restarts. Running drain now.

sarah: Good. Can we enable autoswap to cold-model variant for prefill on failure? That would avoid full container restart.

derek: We have a fallback path but it wasn't wired for prefill. Quick patch: set env PREFILL_FALLBACK=cold_model for the deployment and restart pods in a rolling manner. Doing that now.

priya: Also enabling prefill truncation on the router: set `max_prefill_tokens=32768` as temporary safety.

ashley: Pushing the config change: payload below

```
PATCH /v1/config/routes/long-context
{
  "max_prefill_tokens": 32768,
  "throttle_rps": 0.5
}
```

kevin: Done. Observability: GPU mem usage on node-13 dropped immediately after drain started. Error rate dropped from 12% -> 3% within 90s.

sarah: Customer impact: Support reported ~4% of requests to enterprise-cust-42 saw 502/503 between 21:16-21:22 UTC. Notified AE + support.

oncall-bot: Incident status: mitigation in progress. Postmortem owner requested. Please ack assignment.

priya: I'll take postmortem (priya). Will gather logs, flamegraphs, and sample payloads causing large prefill.

ashley: Rolling hotpatch to add defensive checks to prefill allocator to avoid allocation spikes (small patch, no restart required). Deployed at 21:25 UTC.

derek: Patch added guard `if (requested_prefill > kv_capacity) trim_prefill()` and falls back to streaming prefill. Patch logs: `prefill_trimmed=true` for telemetry.

kevin: We're keeping the node cordoned for now and will reintroduce after a 1h soak.

sarah: Next actions: (1) Postmortem (priya) due EOD tomorrow; (2) Add automated route-level prefill limits; (3) Evaluate KV cache sizing and eviction algorithm.

priya: Noted. I'll include recommendation for adaptive prefill throttling and a quick experiment to enforce fallback earlier in the pipeline.

ashley: Customer update draft: "We experienced GPU OOMs caused by unusually long prefill requests. We applied throttles and fallback logic; error rates reduced. We'll follow up with permanent mitigations and a postmortem." Anyone edit?

sarah: LGTM. Send from support channel and link to incident doc.

oncall-bot: Incident moved to "mitigated" at 21:30 UTC. Will keep monitoring for 60m. :eyes:
